source: Strategia Marki i Komunikacji 2026 (Dowody, claimy i gotowosc publikacyjna, v1 2026-08-26)
rule: No entry means do not use. Only PUBLIC claims may appear in public content without a cleared condition.

claims.claim: We take responsibility for the systems your business makes money on, as if they were our own.
claims.condition: The only brand promise. English wording is a working translation; confirm before website use.

claims.claim: The Codest has product-builder DNA from AdTaily and Yieldbird
claims.condition: Verify each number and award separately.

claims.claim: We offer Product Development, Staff Augmentation and AI
claims.condition: The client's problem leads the story.

claims.claim: AI is used in engineering and prototyping
claims.condition: No guaranteed results; process description must be approved.

claims.claim: A prototype can be ready in as little as 24 hours
claims.condition: Define scope and show an example before publishing.

claims.claim: We can grow a team by 10 people in a month
claims.condition: Not an SLA, not a website claim.

claims.claim: Senior-only
claims.condition: Needs a definition of seniority and process confirmation.

claims.claim: A team can start in under 30 days
claims.condition: Needs a counting method and case history.

claims.claim: MUFG: scale and ratings
claims.condition: 1:1 only after contract check and approval; publicly blocked.

claims.claim: Allegro: Team Extension with Delivery Responsibility
claims.condition: 1:1 only after contract check and approval; never add business KPIs.

claims.claim: "They treat the project like their own" (public review)
claims.condition: Check reuse rules and attribution.

claims.claim: Revenue plan 2026-2029
claims.condition: Never in marketing.

claims.claim: Number of clients is not a KPI
claims.condition: Block any client-count targets.

claims.claim: AI is the brand's main differentiator
claims.condition: Decision only after two full quarters of testing.

claims.claim: The US is a target market
claims.condition: Market withdrawn.

claims.claim: GFT is a Codest client
claims.condition: GFT is an intermediary, not a client.

claims.claim: Teams can stay with a client for years
claims.condition: Confirm distribution of relationship length and population.

claims.claim: EUR 3-6.5m of new revenue a year is the target
claims.condition: Use the current financial plan internally only.

claims.claim: The target is 4-6 or 10-13 new clients
claims.condition: Client count is not a KPI.

claims.claim: The hiring limit is 12 people
claims.condition: Use role-specific planning assumptions.

claims.claim: Poland applies only to Group 1
claims.condition: Poland applies to all three groups.

claims.claim: MUFG or Allegro can be shown publicly if anonymised
claims.condition: Formal consent is required even for anonymised use.

blocked_phrases: Claude Code on the Allegro project
